svg.title: How deep you go in each part of the graph
svg.desc: The same planning graph with two shaded areas. The darker area is where the owner started: the manifesto and the two things the team wants. The lighter area is where the owner went deeper since: the weekday timeline down to its code, and the node that highlights what moved. Everything else is left to the agent: the code that marks moved dates, and the whole branch below let anyone propose changes, with its JSON file, pull requests, schema check and code.
